note: Generic rules derived from PUBLIC manufacturer type codes (catalogue order keys). No customer data, no project data. Every value is a hint for modelling — verify it in the model (web_check_gap / web_check_contact) before you rely on it.

parts.kind: guided drive (pneumatic cylinder with guide yoke)
parts.referencePoint: Stroke 0 = retracted end position; the guide yoke with both guide rods moves, the housing is mounted.
Stroke 0 = retracted end position; only the piston rod (and what is mounted on it) moves.
Stroke 0 = slide at one end position; the slide travels along the profile, the profile is mounted.
Stroke 0 = retracted end position; the slide moves, the housing is mounted.

parts.strokeHint: The type code carries no stroke — the stroke per jaw depends on the size; take it from the datasheet and cite it.
parts.referencePoint: Two jaws move symmetrically; model one axis per jaw or one master with a Drive_Gear slave (factor -1).

parts.kind: electric axis (toothed belt TB or ball screw BS), guide KF
parts.referencePoint: Stroke 0 = slide at the reference (homing) end; the working stroke in the code excludes reserve stroke.

parts.strokeHint: Rotary — no stroke; model as a rotary drive (degrees).
parts.referencePoint: Rotation about the axis of the rotary plate; 0 deg = homing position.
